sections.title: ATHA brings education, research, industry, talent, experience design, and AI-nat
sections.text: It develops future changemakers and demonstrates that outstanding innovation and human flourishing can strengthen one another. In this vision, AI is understood as contextual intelligence, not merely automation, and people and AI create together without surrendering human judgment or responsibility.

sections.title: ATHA exists to create AI-native innovation experiences where people work on real
sections.text: It enables better decisions about AI use, fosters healthier and more human ways of working, and connects education, research, talent, and industry through a global ecosystem that solves consequential problems.

sections.title: Warwick Business School contributes academic environment, knowledge, participant
sections.text: Its role is not merely supportive but integral to the experience design behind ATHA, helping shape changemakers who combine artificial and human intelligence with ethics, creativity, and organisational design.

sections.title: ATHA serves education and research by providing a living environment for methodo
sections.text: It allows OneMundi’s emerging methodology to be applied to real challenges, tested by diverse teams, challenged academically, observed in practice, measured, modified, versioned, and improved continuously.

sections.title: The current state of the first ATHA edition is taking shape around Warwick Busin
sections.text: It involves around 45 selected participants in nine multidisciplinary teams of five, working on three real enterprise AI challenges with three independent teams per challenge. The core working location is Warwick/Coventry, with a multi-day working experience at Warwick Business School.

sections.title: Every ATHA edition follows a rhythm of arrival, sensing, connecting, creating, d
sections.text: Participants arrive and settle into a made room, open the question before attacking it, form teams across disciplines, engage in AI-native investigation, weigh evidence and trade-offs, share recognition of different excellences, and leave with integrated insights that carry into the next edition.

stages.name: Arrive & Settle
stages.description: People are met rather than processed; the room is made, not booked.

stages.name: Open & Sense
stages.description: The question is opened before it is attacked, presented as it actually sits.

stages.name: Connect
stages.description: Teams form across disciplines, around the question.

stages.name: Create
stages.description: The longest stage: AI-native investigation, AI used fully, never accepted blindly.

stages.name: Discern
stages.description: Evidence, consequences, uncertainty, trade-offs — given more room than any stage except the work itself.

stages.name: Celebrate
stages.description: Recognition is shared rather than ranked; different forms of excellence, no overall winner.

stages.name: Integrate & Return
stages.description: Leave with something integrated; the relationships carry into the next edition.

sections.text: OneMundi brings enterprise transformation, the AI-native methodology, the commercial model, the independence of the verdict, and the continuing ecosystem. Warwick Business School provides the academic environment, knowledge, participants, research, network, and institutional standards.

layers.name: OneMundi

layers.name: Warwick Business School
layers.description: Partner and co-host. Academic environment, knowledge, participants, research, network and institutional standards.
